text: {"name":"ioctl2_read_selected_fields","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Loads a validated 320-byte record and copies the payload segments selected by the request mask into the caller buffer.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"a1":"request_mask","a2":"output_buffer","a3":"output_capacity","v6":"copied_length","v8":"record_magic","v9":"available_flags"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Record magic checked against the expected constant."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Flags indicating which requested data is available."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Six-byte payload copied when request bit 0x2 is available."},{"offset":292,"meaning":"Two-byte payload selected by request bit 0x100000."},{"offset":296,"meaning":"Eight-byte payload selected by request bit 0x200000."},{"offset":304,"meaning":"Four-byte payload selected by request bit 0x400000."},{"offset":308,"meaning":"Two-byte payload selected by request bit 0x800000."},{"offset":310,"meaning":"Ten-byte payload selected by request bit 0x1000000."}]}
